scoring.average_precision_skill: clip((Average Precision - evaluation prevalence) / (1 - evaluation prevalence), 0, 1)
scoring.combined_score: Unweighted mean of FA AUC skill, FA AP skill, FA temporal recovery, GI AUC skill, GI AP skill, and GI temporal recovery.
scoring.finalist_rank: Descending mean combined validation score minus one sample SD across sampling seeds; mean combined score and candidate_id break ties.
scoring.pareto_reporting: A finalist is Pareto-optimal when no other finalist is at least as good on all six mean normalized components and strictly better on at least one. Pareto status is reported but does not replace the predeclared stability-adjusted ranking.
scoring.temporal_recovery: Mean per-split overlap fraction with the outcome's known temporal region on the correct anchor. For a used interval W and true interval T, relevance = length(W intersection T) / length(W). Wrong anchors, Full Timeline, and zero-width windows receive 0.
